objective.title: Qualify provider-independent public capability discovery and missing-result integration boundaries

declared.summary: Close M2-W02-C01 by falsifying absent provider-independent discovery, delivering immutable public capability enumeration without provider or permission binding, and verifying no-result, provenance and public-assembly boundaries with eight GREEN tests, prior T1 and IR regressions and local NuGet packaging.
declared.value: Consumers can enumerate stable inspectable composition descriptions and distinguish unrecognized operations or incomplete results without assuming installed providers, AURA permissions, or mathematical execution.
debtChanges: M2-W02 remains in progress: M2-W02-C02 typed direct/fluent pipeline and M2-W02-C03 composition work are untouched.
Capabilities remain descriptive; neither Find nor Discover identifies provider availability, authorizes work, or performs execution.
Bounded provenance is metadata, not an execution log, permission token or external-provider attestation.
No mathematical solver, numerical provider, pipeline scheduler, AURA host linkage, external package publishing, or consumer adoption is introduced.
declared.nextAction: Proceed with a substantial M2-W02-C02-T1 contract and independent RED/GREEN for typed direct and fluent pipelines with unit dimension validation, without claiming execution across unavailable providers.

achievements.achievement: A targeted independently executable test observes controlled RED when the provider-independent public capability catalog is missing.
The composition assembly exposes immutable capability discovery and exact known-id lookup without provider, permission, executor, AURA or runtime binding.
Eight adversarial boundary tests, seven prior contract tests, IR and foundation regression, architecture verification and local package structure qualification demonstrate bounded semantics.
The independent public-provider, permission and no-final-value integration boundaries have been qualified; no external adoption or execution is inferred.
Both contract task T1 and the completed T2 boundary/integration task satisfy the phase closure criteria while M2-W02 stays in progress.
